fix_script = '''import sys, json, sqlite3

sys.path.insert(0, 'skills/tau2Airline/src')

conn = sqlite3.connect('world.db')
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
cur = conn.cursor()

valid_cabins = {"economy", "business", "basic_economy"}
valid_statuses = {"available", "delayed", "on time", "cancelled", "landed", "flying"}

# Get all tau2Airline flights and fix issues
cur.execute("SELECT flight_id, departure_time, arrival_time, cabin_prices_json, dates_json FROM flights WHERE source_skill='tau2Airline'")
rows = cur.fetchall()
print(f"Found {len(rows)} tau2Airline flights to fix")

fixed = 0
for row in rows:
    fid = row["flight_id"]
    dep = row["departure_time"] or ""
    arr = row["arrival_time"] or ""

    # Fix cabin_prices_json
    cp = json.loads(row["cabin_prices_json"] or "{}")
    cp_filtered = {k: v for k, v in cp.items() if k in valid_cabins}

    # Fix dates_json - remove invalid cabins AND fix invalid statuses
    dates = json.loads(row["dates_json"] or "{}")
    for date_key, date_val in dates.items():
        if isinstance(date_val, dict):
            # Fix status: map "active" -> "available", any other unknown -> "available"
            if "status" in date_val and date_val["status"] not in valid_statuses:
                date_val["status"] = "available"
            if "prices" in date_val and isinstance(date_val["prices"], dict):
                date_val["prices"] = {k: v for k, v in date_val["prices"].items() if k in valid_cabins}
            if "available_seats" in date_val and isinstance(date_val["available_seats"], dict):
                date_val["available_seats"] = {k: v for k, v in date_val["available_seats"].items() if k in valid_cabins}

    cur.execute(
        "UPDATE flights SET departure_time=?, arrival_time=?, cabin_prices_json=?, dates_json=? WHERE flight_id=?",
        (dep, arr, json.dumps(cp_filtered), json.dumps(dates), fid)
    )
    fixed += 1

conn.commit()
print(f"Fixed {fixed} flights")

# Now load via the SDK
from tau2.domains.airline.data_model import FlightDB
from tau2.domains.airline.tools import AirlineTools

db = FlightDB.load()
tools = AirlineTools(db)
print("FlightDB loaded successfully!")

# 1. Reservation details
print("\\n=== RESERVATION B75309 ===")
res = tools.get_reservation_details("B75309")
print(res.model_dump_json(indent=2))

# 2. User details
print("\\n=== USER DETAILS ===")
user = tools.get_user_details("user_59b22691")
print(user.model_dump_json(indent=2))

# 3. Flight status
print("\\n=== FLIGHT FL398507 on 2026-09-16 ===")
flight = tools.get_flight_status("FL398507", "2026-09-16")
print(flight.model_dump_json(indent=2))

conn.close()
'''
await write_file("./tau2_fix_and_query.py", fix_script)
print("Script written")
